name: Cyclopean Mummy
flavour: One eye, one mace, no patience.
art_prompt: a squat goblin mummy: its big round head and pot belly wrapped in one mass of thick cream-white bandages, one huge glowing green cat-eye with a black slit pupil staring out of the wrappings in the middle of its head, two long pointed goblin ears poking out at the sides, wiry grey-brown goblin arms and bandy legs, a ragged dark brown loincloth, a black iron spiked ball mace on a long dark shaft held in both hands
motion: plodding forward in place with heavy bandy-legged steps, the spiked mace held up at its shoulder
doc: A squat goblin wrapped head to belly in bandages, one big green slit-pupilled eye staring out of the wrappings; it plods after the hero with a spiked mace held up at its shoulder.
back_hint: Seen from behind: the bandaged round back of its head and body, the two pointed ears and the mace poking out at the sides, no eye visible.
dead_hint: a collapsed heap of loose cream-white bandages lying on the ground, the big green eye shut on top, the spiked mace lying across the heap

CM-0.note: the top-level strip, before the Level Editor's looks
